line_items.work_text: Safety audit of high rise buildings: GMDA was to undertake Safety Audit of 324 G+4 and above Multi storied buildings in Guwahati city and complete the same within six months i.e. July 2013.

Safety audit of water treatment plants: GMC informed SEC that Assam Engineering College has submitted a Techno- financial proposal to GMC amounting to Rs. 40.00 lakh for carrying out the technical safety audit of the GMC water supply works.

narrative: SEC directed GMDA to complete the safety audit of the balance 35 buildings within a month i.e. by 30th September 2013. SEC further directed GMDA to submit the status note on the already completed safety audit of 289 buildings to ASDMA within a week. SEC directed GDD to examine whether the fund amounting to Rs. 40.00 lakh would be adequate to complete the exercise and arrange to provide the required fund to GMC by placing a Supplementary Demand proposal, if necessary.
